It is hung by its slide so both cord-ends fall straight and vertical, their metal tips dangling and nearly touching, reading the as-worn drop with zero body present; the piece occupies about 35 percent of the frame, off-center to the right against generous slate negative space on the left. The single cool accent is the oxidized iron of the hook itself.
